about: Jude is a short letter asking believers to hold on to their faith.

pages.title: God Will Keep You
pages.scene: A child holding God's hand on a steep path
pages.text: Jude told his friends to stay strong in faith, to keep themselves in God's love, and to be kind to people who doubt. He ended with a happy prayer: "God is able to keep you from falling!"
pages.lesson: God can keep you from falling.
